title: Recheck same-path retired-check eligibility against the fresh phase-two source
outcome: A same-path predecessor that becomes admissible after a disposition note is written is refused for exclusion against the fresh source bracket, without granting or rewriting credit.
acceptance: A behavioral race test changes the same named root back to the acknowledged predecessor's source between phases and proves that a now-admissible check is not excluded.
Different-path retired checks and genuinely root-rebound same-path predecessors retain their request-local audited behavior; no original run, acknowledgement or outcome is rewritten.
